pages.title: Hartebeest
pages.text: The hartebeest ($(o)Alcelaphus buselaphus$()) is a red-brown antelope of the African savanna.$(br2)It has a very long, narrow face, and its ringed horns grow from a bony base on top of the skull and bend sharply backwards.$(br2)Bulls defend small territories, often standing guard on a termite mound.
